name: recon_skill
description: Data reconciliation toolkit for comparing any two datasets and finding discrepancies. Supports configurable join keys, threshold-based matching (numeric, date, fuzzy text), profile-based saved configurations, and structured exports. Triggers: recon, reconciliation, compare data, find discrepancies, data matching, run recon, build recon profile, create reconciliation, match datasets, break analysis, discrepancy report.
